name: Chandelier BY G
notes: Photo 1 is the breakfast/lunch/Mexican-menu page, photo 2 is the dinner menu (adds Appetizers, French Onion Soup, Chef Special of the Day, beers/wines/cocktails), photo 3 is a Happy Hour flyer that only re-prices appetizers and drinks already captured, so it was skipped. Items repeated verbatim across pages (e.g. Chicken Piccata, Shrimp Scampi entree, Menudo, Molletes) were merged once. Menu prints 'Shrimp Scampi' twice at different prices/portions (entree $22 vs appetizer $19) and 'Pineapple Azalea Margarita' twice ($14 and $15); both distinct prints are kept since they read as different menu entries. A few items had illegible/blurred trailing prices and were recorded without one.
